title: Capability maturity as a refutable claim, over pytest output
scope: Machine-readable manifests and a checker that validates them and executes every declared gate, failing if the recorded test counts no longer hold. Reads pytest's summary line.
assumptions: A checker that only ever passes is worth nothing, so its self-test asserts that specific false claims are refused.
Counts are read from the runner's own summary, so a changed output format is treated as unreadable rather than as passing.

verification.description: Proves the checker refuses 17 distinct false claims, including a pytest count that differs from the claim.

known_failures: Three of 27 repositories carry manifests; the rest have no machine-readable evidence.
Generating white-paper claims from manifests, G18's stated end state, is not built.
